identity: One phosphor, one voice: the core square-wave voice does all routine chrome, arps jump in hard steps (never slides) to match steps() motion, noise-register cues are reserved for print/static/danger, and danger is loudness plus downward motion, never a second timbre family. Frequent cues (typing, log arrivals, hovers) sit at the bottom of the loudness ladder (vol <= 0.3, short decay); one-shot moments get punch.
